refutationConditions.text: OP-AR-1 is refuted if any tier block's landed exactness classification falls outside the binary predicate (e.g., a block agrees on all but one instance while the exactness expectation demanded a clean degradation profile); the near-exact sub-category is then the finding, never a pass

OP-AR-2 is refuted if the field's exactness profile is set-independent (the A0 and A1 profiles coincide in reconstruction exactness, net rate, and own-tier classification) - then the coupling does not depend on the anchor set

OP-AR-3 is refuted if the office transport on any Klein-4 involution-pair anchor family or fixed anchor family is fragmented (the field varies within a family pair's transport) - then the coupling does not respect the derived coordinate structure
OP-AR-4 is refuted if any tier block's landed pattern falls outside the zero-mismatch tolerance of the derived-input prediction; the mismatching fields name the interaction's remainder content

synthesis.d7Tier: D7 remains hypothesis-tier: no D7 claim event, no D7 record amendment, no D7 derivation admission; ENTRY 15's D7 clause carries forward verbatim
findings: the office field's support is exactly the non-boundary partition: 308 office-carrying records (70 anchors + 238 satellites), 154 office-withheld boundary records
the anchor field is the mask rule office = (C - pcSum) mod 7 with C = 4 (the kappa orientation constant): 70/70 anchors
every satellite carries its governing anchor's office: 238/238; the satellite-side structure adds no independent office content
the +2 governor-successor step holds along all ten landed modal orbits on both fields
the midpoint law extends to A2 (7/7): the A-tier office field is fully kappa-derivable (A0 position, A1 midpoint, A2 midpoint-of-midpoints)
OP-AR-1: 57 blocks, 11 exact, 33 degenerate, 13 partial, 0 near-exact; the partition stratifies the field completely

OP-AR-2: ANCHOR_SET_DEPENDENT - reconstruction exact on both sets (7/7, 7/7), but the agreement-field exactness depends on the set (A1 own-tier 24/24 exact; A0 own-tier 36/48 partial; net A0 42/96 vs A1 34/132) and the transport form differs (D7<->A0 affine; D6<->A1 non-affine)

OP-AR-3: BLOCK_CONSTANT_ON_ANCHOR_FAMILIES - the office transport is a well-defined whole permutation on all 10 anchor families under all 3 maps (30/30), covering the Klein-4 involution pairs and the fixed families; the satellite-side carries 14 coarse fragment loci

OP-AR-4: INTERACTION_DERIVED - the predicted field matches the landed field node-by-node (70/70 + 238/238), the agreement field matches instance-by-instance (0/1128 mismatches), and every pattern matches field-for-field
synthesis.remainderStatement: the office field's content beyond the derived-input class is exactly zero within this probe's scope: its values are mask arithmetic (pcSum) + the one orientation constant + the governing structure; its interaction pattern with the anchor sets and the tier/role partition is derived. The anchoring remainder's effective size shrinks to its named residual: the tier/role partition and edge content (GOV-524/525's derived-up-to-remainder class), the one orientation bit (BL-063/BL-065), and presentation conventions
synthesis.scope: the anchoring remainder's interaction structure: the office field's coupling to the anchor sets (A0/A1) and the tier/role partition over the 462-record ledger
synthesis.significance: read together with BL-080 Gate 3's provenance-independence (the pipeline's output is independent of the inputs' provenance), this probe's result completes the independence at the relationships level: the office field's coupling structure - where it is exact, where it degrades, how it respects the tier blocks and the anchor sets - is derived from the same machinery that derives the values. The un-granting program is characterized at its deepest available level: not only the values but the relationships are derived, up to the named remainder. No GOVERNS admission, no claim event: the characterization is planning evidence
